records.researcher_notes: The 2024 Duke Energy Kentucky plan is at https://psc.ky.gov/pscecf/2024-00197/e.rolfes-adkins%40duke-energy.com/09092024025857/DEK_IRP_PUBLIC_06212024.pdf Where to find it: - Page 3 of the plan, in the Executive Summary: 'the addition of a combined cycle (CC) at East Bend beginning in 2039.' - The resource table next to it lists East Bend at 664 MW. - The June 21, 2024 date comes from the filing date in the commission's file name, 06212024.
